idea-plugin.name: Spectra Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
Browse Spectra changes without leaving the IDE.
Spectra moves parked changes out of openspec/changes/ and into the git directory, where the project tree never shows them. This plugin adds a Spectra tool window that lists active, parked and archived changes side by side, shows task progress for each one, and opens their Markdown artifacts in the editor. It reads the files directly, so the Spectra app does not need to be running.
Unofficial: a community-built third-party plugin, not affiliated with or endorsed by Spectra. Spectra-related names belong to their respective owners.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.5.1

  • The plugin and its tool window now carry their own icon — a prism splitting light into a spectrum — instead of the platform's generic structure icon. No functional changes.

0.5.0

  • Send a Spectra command straight to your terminal: right-click a change and pick Send to Terminal to put /spectra-apply, /spectra-ingest, /spectra-archive or /spectra-commit, already carrying that change's name, at the prompt of the terminal tab you currently have selected. The command is typed for you but never run — you press Enter yourself, so picking the wrong tab costs nothing more than a line you can delete.
  • With the Terminal tool window closed or empty the same menu reads Copy Command and writes that line to the clipboard instead. The menu title always states which of the two it is about to do.

0.4.1

  • Release notes are now shipped with the plugin, so this page finally has a What's new section. No functional changes.

0.4.0

  • Change nodes show the proposer, read from created_by in each change's .openspec.yaml, in all three groups. Only the name is shown, never the email address, and a change without a usable name shows no placeholder.

0.3.0

  • Copy change names: select one or more change nodes and press the IDE's Copy shortcut, or right-click and choose Copy Change Name. You get the bare name — no group prefix, no progress counts — one per line for a multiple selection.

0.2.2

  • Build fix: dropped the Kotlin jvm-default compatibility bridges that made the Marketplace verifier report deprecated and experimental API usage the plugin never called.

0.2.1

  • Documentation and packaging only: added the README and the MIT license. No functional changes.

0.2.0

  • Sorting within each group by Name, Modified or Created — Modified (newest first) is the default, and entries with an unknown date always sort last.
  • Name filter: type to filter change names in real time, case-insensitive, across all three groups at once.

0.1.0

  • First release: a Spectra tool window listing Active, Parked and Archived changes side by side, with the change count on each group.
  • Task progress parsed from each change's tasks.md, shown as completed／total.
  • Double-click an artifact node to open its Markdown in the editor.
  • Git worktree support: when .git is a file, the real git directory is resolved through gitdir: and commondir so parked changes are still found.
